note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Mullanahoe was the only contest of the sixteen seats; the other fourteen nominees were returned unopposed and Killycolpy, which received no nomination, was filled by the retiring member deemed re-elected. All sixteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 10 June 1967, p. 13). Returned unopposed.
